activity.notes: Shuja-ud-Din Muhammad Khan ruled Bengal from 1727 to 1739. Contemporary Mughal administrative usage treated the office as nazim/subahdar rather than a formally independent kingship, while the Bengal nawabs were effectively autonomous in practice. ATLAS therefore uses the historically specific Bengal Subah polity rather than the game-style label 'Bengal Empire'.

sources.title: Shujauddin Muhammad Khan — Banglapedia
sources.citation_text: Banglapedia identifies Shujauddin Muhammad Khan as nawab of Bengal from 1727 to 1739 and describes his administration of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa.
